import boto3
from hashlib import sha256
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

import requests

# Define the processing function

        s3_response = s3.get_object(Bucket='your-bucket-name', Key=file_name)
        log_data = s3_response['Body'].read()
        
        # Compute the SHA-256 hash of the log data
